slides.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original bespoke full-bleed 16:9 photographic background for a professional Korean road-operations project presentation called RoadOps. Generate one single image, wide 2048x1152 composition. A quiet two-lane road inspired by Jeju Island, South Korea, in gentle heavy rain and low mist. Dark basalt stone roadside wall, restrained deep green vegetation, realistic wet charcoal asphalt with modest reflections, correct Korean road markings, the road curves into mist in the RIGHT HALF of frame. No specific real location or documented disaster. Calm, precise editorial cinematography with natural textures, charcoal/steel-blue tones and tiny moss-green accents. Composition is essential: the LEFT 42 percent is intentionally very dark low-detail shadow and mist, visually continuous with the scene, suitable for overlaying white slide typography; the recognizable road and vanishing point occupy the right half. Refined, believable, not dramatic catastrophe or tourism postcard. Natural light, no glossy CGI, no HDR, no neon, no oversaturation. No cars, no people, no emergency workers, no buildings, no signage with lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no text. Do not add any graphic elements or typography. This is a conceptual scenario recreation, not evidence photography. Create from scratch, not using or imitating a news photograph.

slides.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original scenario-recreation photograph for a Korean road-operations project presentation, landscape 4:3. Subject: ONE adult road-management coordinator working INDOORS in a modest modern situation room, not a field inspector. Three-quarter side / over-the-shoulder medium view. Person in plain navy office clothing sits at a desk reviewing a paper work plan with a pen, looking toward several monitoring screens showing softly out-of-focus road maps, weather radar and rainy road camera feeds. The person and their act of planning are the focal point, occupying about 55 percent of the frame; head, hands and desk visible, believable posture and anatomy. No helmet, no reflective vest, no uniform insignia. Mood: quiet concentration, practical public-service control room, not a futuristic command center or gamer cave. Match the established RoadOps photographic palette: charcoal and steel blue, subdued greens, gentle overcast rainy-day light; realistic skin and materials, balanced exposure so the face and hands are readable. A window suggests rainy conditions outside. Avoid dramatic emergency alarm lighting, neon, flashy sci-fi HUDs, heroic poses or stock-photo handshakes. Screen content is generic illustrative context, no legible words, no fake exact product UI, no agency logos, no flags, no brands, no watermark, no text overlaid on photo. This is an original fictional scene inspired by Jeju road-management work, not evidence of an actual institution or staff member. Do not create large blank typography space; slide typography will be outside image.

slides.current_layout: Full-bleed rainy road closure scene; native editable white typography on the quiet left area, barrier visible on the right.
slides.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original 16:9 full-bleed transition image for a RoadOps project submission presentation. A rain-soaked road inspired by Jeju Island, dark volcanic basalt walls and muted greenery, low mist, wet charcoal asphalt and natural reflected overcast light. On the RIGHTMOST 40 percent of the image, a short row of realistic orange reflective traffic cones with a simple portable striped road-closure barrier clearly closes a side road. This is a modest controlled access closure, no wreckage, no deep flood, no victims, no vehicles, no people. Cinematic but restrained editorial composition. Keep the LEFT 55 percent naturally very dark and uncluttered with blurred wet roadside and shadow for large white editable text to be overlaid later; do not place the cones or important details behind that text region. Steel-blue/charcoal palette, muted green vegetation, small orange barrier accents for narrative tension. Photorealistic textures, soft rain, no glossy CGI, no HDR, no oversized dramatic hazard signage, no lettering, logos, numbers, watermark or graphic overlay. Single continuous image, not collage. Fictional what-if scenario, not a photo of a real closure.

slides.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: a single editorial illustration for slide 3 of a professional Korean RoadOps road-management planning presentation. Landscape 4:3 illustration on pure white #FFFFFF background. A clean, refined flat line-art aerial illustration inspired by the elongated oval outline of Jeju Island, with a sparse simplified road network, one highlighted blue route and three small green waypoint dots, plus one modest unbranded road-maintenance pickup truck as an understated secondary element near a route. Abstract conceptual geography only; do not imply exact road alignments or actual dispatch data. Use crisp medium-weight strokes in brand blue #1468B3, occasional muted lime green #8CC63F, and very light ice-blue fills. A tiny soft pale-blue rain cloud over part of the island can connect to the rainy-day planning scenario. Stylish grown-up editorial information design, no cartoon faces, no people, no childish clipart, no 3D, no photorealism, no gradients, no shadows. Composition is spacious and balanced with the island and route the focal point, smoothly integrated into white slide background, generous white outer margin. Do not include lettering, labels, legends, numbers, logos, watermark, arrows, UI cards or frames. This is decorative conceptual art; all numeric resource quantities and textual explanation will remain separate native slide text.

decorative_backgrounds.role: Reusable white background with light neutral-gray route lines and blue/green waypoint dots only. Cover excluded. Decorative only; no geographic data.
decorative_backgrounds.prompt: Edit the supplied RoadOps decorative slide background. Change ONLY the colors of the road/path lines. Every continuous path stroke, including the main left-edge vertical route with its bend and every curved stroke in the upper-right corner, must become a subtle light NEUTRAL GRAY, around #D2D6DA for the main lines and #E9ECEF for the faint secondary lines. No blue or cyan may remain in ANY line segment. Preserve the small filled circular waypoint dots exactly: the lower-left dot stays brand blue #1468B3, the upper-left dot and upper-right endpoint stay lime green #8CC63F. Only these circular dots should carry blue or green color. Preserve the original line geometry, thickness, positions, dot sizes, aspect ratio, pure white background, large central empty area, and all spacing. Do not add any new elements, shadows, texture, gradients, text, logos or labels. The lines should sit quietly behind presentation content, with the colored dots as the sole accents. This is a targeted color edit, not a redesign.
decorative_backgrounds.reference_role: Edit target. Preserve geometry and dots; recolor all route strokes to gray.

superseded_decorative_backgrounds.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create a refined minimal road-route brand motif on a perfectly pure white #FFFFFF 2048x1152 canvas. The central 88 percent of the slide must remain completely blank pure white for editable slide content. Decorative artwork is confined to a narrow strip at the extreme LEFT edge and a small shallow area at the TOP RIGHT corner. At left, one precise thin blue route line (#1468B3), entering from off-canvas at mid-height, bends once, runs vertically close to the edge, with two restrained small waypoint dots, one lime green #8CC63F. Keep all left motif within the first 3 percent of canvas width. At top right, a small elegant set of sparse very pale ice-blue road contours curves off the top and right edges, with one short stronger blue segment and one tiny green endpoint. Keep this top-right motif entirely within the rightmost 12 percent of width and uppermost 7 percent of height, so it cannot touch a slide title starting below 8 percent height. Flat precise editorial line art, crisp geometric curves, quiet blue and green punctuation, restrained professional Korean civic-tech identity. No gradients, shadows, grids, cards, boxes, pills, text, letters, numbers, icons, logos, watermarks, maps or photorealism. Do not add anything along the bottom. The vast majority of the image stays pure white. This is purely decorative route-inspired background art, not geographic data.
